info.description: REST API for flight data ingest, job status, route performance, and carrier performance. Protected routes require an API key (`Authorization: Bearer <key>` or `X-API-Key`). Rate-limited responses return 429 with `Retry-After`, `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, and `X-RateLimit-Reset`.
info.title: flight-tracker API

get.description: On-time stats for a marketing carrier, plus best and worst routes and airports (on-time rate, at least 30 flights, top and bottom 5). Dates are optional and default to the trailing 90 days ending at the carrier's latest flight date (max span 366 days).

parameters.description: Range start (YYYY-MM-DD); required if end_date is set
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.description: Range end (YYYY-MM-DD), on or after start_date; required if start_date is set
parameters.name: end_date

post.description: Historical outlook for 2–4 ordered legs and each connection. Always 200. A leg with no history has a null outlook and an error, not empty_sample.

get.description: On-time, delay, cancellation, and diversion probabilities for one carrier, route, weekday, and departure window. A date selects that weekday in the same historical sample. A null delay on a non-empty sample means that delay was not observed.

parameters.description: Weekday (1=Mon … 7=Sun); exactly one of day_of_week or date
parameters.name: day_of_week

parameters.description: Calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD); exactly one of day_of_week or date
parameters.name: date

parameters.description: Minutes around dep_time to include (default 60, max 120)
parameters.name: dep_time_window_minutes

get.description: Aggregated on-time, delay, cancellation, and diversion stats for a route over a date range (max 366 days). When carrier is omitted, carrier_on_time lists per-marketing-carrier on-time rates and flight counts for the same filters. carrier_comparison is ranked when the highest-rate carrier with at least one flight differs at 95% from another, and too_close_to_call when it does not. The carrier list is omitted entirely when carrier is set.

parameters.description: Range end (YYYY-MM-DD), on or after start_date
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.description: Marketing carrier code (required if flight_number is set)
parameters.name: carrier

parameters.description: Marketing flight number, 1 to 4 digits; leading zeros are ignored (0123 and 123 match)
parameters.name: flight_number

get.description: Typical-year on-time rates by month, weekday, and local departure hour, from up to the last 2 years. Every bucket with at least one flight is ranked. Best is the highest-rate bucket plus buckets that do not differ from it at 95%, capped at 3, and only when that bucket differs from another. Worst is the lowest-rate bucket among those it beats, plus buckets tied with that one, capped at 3. Both lists are omitted when the highest-rate bucket differs from nobody.
On-time performance by observed weather category at each end of a route (max 366 days).

parameters.description: Range end (YYYY-MM-DD), on or after start_date
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.description: Marketing carrier code (required if flight_number is set)
parameters.name: carrier

parameters.description: Marketing flight number, 1 to 4 digits; leading zeros are ignored (0123 and 123 match)
parameters.name: flight_number

lookback_days.description: Days of history used: 365, or 730 when a thin default window was widened.

sample_reason.description:
empty_sample means the slot has no flights: confidence is unknown and estimates are null.
sufficient covers medium and high. insufficient_sample is low.

mct_source.description: MCTSource is airport when this bucket used the stored airport minute, or default when that minute was missing.
Null when this hop did not use a connection bucket.

overnight.description: Overnight stays true for a later outbound date, including multi-day, when reason names another cause.

reason.description: Reason is why status is unknown, except overnight, which means a later date was still classified. empty_sample matches the inbound sample_reason when that slot has no flights. A low sample is still classified. missing_outlook does not.

confidence.description: A missing outlook counts as unknown.

connection_risk.description: True when any connection is tight or unknown.

connection.description: Cleared when the slot has no flights. A low sample keeps these thresholds.

adverse_delta.description: AdverseDelta is adverse_on_time_rate minus fair_on_time_rate, or null unless both rates exist.

adverse_flights.description: AdverseFlights counts adverse-category flights. UNKNOWN and unmatched flights are excluded.

adverse_on_time_rate.description: AdverseOnTimeRate is null when this side has no adverse flights.

confidence.description: Confidence follows the thinner of the fair and adverse counts, and is unknown when either count is zero.

fair_on_time_rate.description: FairOnTimeRate is null when this side has no VFR_FAIR flights.

carrier_comparison.description:
CarrierComparison is ranked when the highest-rate compared carrier differs at 95% from at least one other,
and too_close_to_call when it does not. Omitted when fewer than two carriers are compared.

carrier_on_time.description: Present only when the carrier query filter is omitted. Sorted by on_time_rate desc, then flights desc, then carrier asc.

day_comparison.description: DayComparison uses the same rule as month_comparison.

hour_comparison.description: HourComparison uses the same rule as month_comparison.

month_comparison.description:
MonthComparison is ranked when the highest-rate month differs at 95% from another month.
Best months are that month plus months tied with it, capped at 3. Worst months are the lowest-rate month among those it beats, plus months tied with that one, capped at 3. Too close to call leaves both lists empty.

ApiKeyAuth.description: API key as `Bearer <key>`. `X-API-Key` is also accepted.
ApiKeyAuth.name: Authorization
